fixture: Real Failed Pod, controller-only DELETE/POST errors, same-image controller replacement with initialSync, schedulerName=volcano

cases.description: SG整组恢复部分删除后重启，续删原标记prefill，按历史A重建完整SG并保留预算约束下的其他组
SG内Role恢复部分删除后重启，续删原标记entry，重建原Role范围并保留decode
独立Role部分恢复后重启，续删原标记entry，按历史布局重建entry/worker并保持预算
协调Role部分恢复后重启，续删原标记范围，保持协调、历史模板与预算约束

assertions: A full Ready baseline precedes desired B with partition=2

Actual failed UID is gone; the deletion scope is committed and the DELETE that continues it was rejected before restart; no private member CM is required. Without ServingGroup objects: the surviving original has deletion-scope and its DELETE was rejected. With ServingGroup objects (contract 2.14, clause C4; detected from the servinggroups CRD): RC-01 has the group Failed and Drained and the DELETE of the ServingGroup was rejected, RC-02..04 have the Role instance record Draining and the DELETE of the surviving original was rejected; a deletion-scope marker on a Pod does not establish the cut point there
Restart changes controller UID without changing image or template, and completes initialSync
partition 2->1 while stopped; finish marked original scope after restart; preserve all out-of-scope UIDs while POST is blocked, without extra budget
Coordinated Roles submit compatible partitions together (prefill/decode both 2->1->0); only prefill changes template, decode stays A
Every original in the marked Role/SG scope is replaced; first replacement uses historical A and complete applied layout; unmarked replacements are never absorbed
High eligible unit reaches B only after refill; partition 1->0 then converges all eligible units to B
A fresh fault in the continuously running controller still replaces exactly the configured Role/SG scope
limitations: This suite does not migrate the 84 historical recovery cases or prove every roleCoordination/maxSkew/order combination
Pure NotReady, None, grace=-1 and finite grace retain their independent recovery-contract/grace-restart coverage
RUN-436/439 remain the separate rolling-Terminating restart cases
